cause: Windows sharing violation while Chrome was still publishing DevToolsActivePort. This was browser-controller readiness, not a React DOM or timing assertion failure.
fix: Wait only for the owned browser to publish a complete readable endpoint within its existing startup deadline; terminate/wait only for remaining processes in the owned Windows job before removing its private profile.
final_matrices: The entire default-GPU matrix and entire software matrix were run afterward in fresh directories; both completed all eight cells with normal browser exits zero.
